mapper.select: SELECT posts.id AS "id", posts.title AS "title", posts.author_id AS "authorId", posts.created_at AS "createdAt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reactions.type = 'LIKE') AS "likeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reactions.type = 'DISLIKE') AS "dislikeCount" FROM posts LEFT JOIN reactions ON reactions.target_type = 'POST' AND reactions.target_id = posts.id WHERE posts.board_id = #{boardId} AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY posts.id ORDER BY posts.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE posts.board_id = #{boardId} AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL
